raw_response: {"diagnosis": "31 REVERSAL rows point to original transactions through orig_txn_id, and those originals are still marked POSTED. The silver filter only checks status = 'POSTED', so the reversed originals stay in gold and inflate recent totals. I could not see the reversal amounts or whether any are partial, so this is inferred from the schema and profile.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions rv WHERE rv.status = 'REVERSAL' AND rv.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
